key_insight: HAVAPlot enables browser-based scientific visualization and post-processing without software installation or simulation-data uploads.
engineering_relevance: Engineers can inspect native OpenFOAM, VTK, and tabular results locally and export publication-ready figures and processed data.
method: Read native OpenFOAM cases, including polyhedral meshes, binary fields, boundaries, and particles.
Generate exact polyhedral slices, contours, streamlines, isosurfaces, and particle visualizations.
Verify mesh geometry, field reading, and interpolation against independent implementations and analytical fields.
evidence_signal: Validation reproduced 6.1 million field values to machine precision across four production cases; interpolation converged at second order internally and first order at boundaries, while 250,000-cell meshes loaded within 1.3 seconds.
watch_item: Boundary interpolation is only first-order accurate, and browser performance on substantially larger meshes is not established by the abstract.
paper_title: HAVAPlot: A Web-Based Scientific Visualization and Post-Processing Platform
